title: Chapter 830
paragraphs: Chapter 830
Episode 209. Temar's Seventh Tomb - Keitam's Painting (3)

[What? Oh my head, what the hell does that mean? And you just asked me if there was another Murakan, but the one who slaughtered the common people and sent Temar to the bed is a fake Murakan. Call that bastard a fake. He did only the things that upset me.]
"So, you mean the Murakan standing here has no intention to slaughter us...."

[Ah, yes! He's the fake, and I'm the real one. That kid is just a picture drawn by Keitam... no, forget about this. Anyway, stop begging me for your life because of that garbage that tarnishes my name. It makes me look like a bad guy.]
"I'll vouch for his words."
Jin jumped off from Murakan's back and spoke. People were surprised again, apparently unaware that Jin and Shuri had been riding on Murakan's back until then.
Jin was wearing a saga coat adorned with ten black swords. As the clothing of the Runcandel hasn't changed much from a thousand years ago to now, people thought Jin was a knight of Runcandel.
"Are you a knight of Runcandel?"
"Yes, I have been on a long-term external mission with Murakan and was on my way back through a storm. So relax and keep talking. How is the Grand Duke?"
"Well, he was defeated by Murakan...."
[It's a fake!]

"I'm sorry. So, he was defeated by the fake Murakan. We lower beings can't know the exact details, but there was a huge fight in the Black Sea. Thanks to the hasty support of the Ten Knights, he was able to return alive... but there are more than a few people who saw that Temar was hurt."
According to the villagers, the Ten Knights apparently had a chase with the fake Murakan after rescuing Temar.
The chase continued from the Black Sea to Mitel, and in the process, the Ten Knights suffered both large and small injuries. The fake Murakan stopped the attack only after they barely reached Mitel.

"....The mainstream view is that the fake probably found it burdensome to fight directly with the remaining Ten Knights and all the forces of Runcandel in Mitel. But the fake not only avoids a frontal fight, but he also continues to attack various places in the Huphester Alliance, including the Kingdom of Mitel."
"He's trying to drain us."
"Yes... it could also be because he couldn't pinpoint Temar's location. He must have considered that Temar could return after healing with Numéru's divine water... that's all we know."
"I see. Thank you for telling me, we should head to Storm Castle now."
As Jin climbed back onto Murakan's back, the villagers exchanged glances and sighed in relief. It was unbelievable to them that they had survived after facing Murakan.
[Don't worry everyone. That damn fake, the kid and I will definitely take him down.]
[Meow! Meow meow!]
Shuri also lifted her forefoot and flared her battle spirit.
"Thank you, thank you!"
"Of course, there's no way Lord Murakan, the Guardian Dragon of Runcandel, would do such a thing. This is the real Murakan...!"
"Please make sure to punish him!"
The group left the village, receiving the desperate cheers of the people.

[Kid, cancel slowly looking around and go full speed now. Hmm, it seems one of the guardians that Lord Keitam drew was me of this time, and it seems crazy because of the guy who polluted the picture?]
"Maybe so."

[Oh, it's disgusting. I'm mad. Even if it's in the picture, a guy who looks like me, uses my name, and has the same power as me is doing this. I'll find both the fake guy and the one who polluted the picture and tear them all apart.]
As Murakan cursed and cut across the sky, Jin recalled the record he saw in the second tomb in the past.
-There really is a tower... you say that the Lord is in there. Oh... Murakan, is there really no other way? I'm honestly not confident.
-Temar is weak. I can deal with it alone. The reason I called you is just....
-No, I'm not sure if this is right. To kill the Lord with our hands, isn't it too cruel? To the Lord, or to us.
-Don't hesitate now that you've come this far, Padler. Do you think I want to kill him? I can't express it in any words, this miserable feeling. It hurts me too.
The conversation between Murakan and Padler from the record.

'According to the record, there really was a tower in the Black Sea... and there was Temar, who looked like he was obsessed. And when Murakan tried to finish off Temar with Padler and Sarah, Orgal appeared. Orgal suggested one way to save Temar.'
He couldn't see what the suggestion was because the record was cut off.

'It's true that Murakan and Temar fought in the tower in the Black Sea. It was almost unilateral suppression of the weakened Temar. Is what's happening in the picture now due to pollution related to that time?'
Whatever happened a thousand years ago that Keitam left behind, you would have to solve the pollution to properly understand it.
"Murakan."
[Why?]
"But if we go to the Storm Fortress like this, won't we be attacked? The fake one looks just like you. I think the people in the Storm Fortress now would have to misunderstand."

[I can't take it easy, though. Anyway, at least now you have to be at the level of the Ten Knights to attack, so ignore the rest and go straight. The conversation can be explained carefully when we get to the Storm Fortress.]
"Hmm, it would be nice if the misunderstanding was easily solved by words. Let's set up a few situations first. Because we have to explain our existence."
The Murakan mountain began to come into view after two hours of flight.
During their journey, Jin and his party saw each province lighting beacons and firing signal flares at their sight.
Understandably, nearby cities including the Storm Castle had finished preparing for the attack.
"It looks like an evacuation procession. They must have issued an evacuation order, which means they're willing to fight, even if it means destroying the entire city," Jin said.
Before Jin could finish speaking, sword auras and bombardments came flying from somewhere on the ground. About three thousand knights spread out an anti-aircraft sword barrier.
However, the multitude of sword auras couldn't even scratch Murakan. Murakan quickly gained altitude towards the Storm Castle. From then on, the knights' sword auras didn't even reach the group.

Knights alone practically couldn't do anything when dealing with a dragon, especially a distinctively strong one like Murakan. Magicians could unleash continuous magic in a group or bombard them with long-distance magic, but knights were only effective in ground battles.
However, the story was different for exceptional warriors like the Ten Knights.

A threatening strike suddenly flew from the middle of the mountain. The sword aura, which cut a lump out of the protective shield that Murakan had spread out, didn't require visual confirmation to identify its owner.
"A Ten Knight."
[Yes, they're the only ones who can penetrate my shield like this. I wonder who it is? Whomever it is, it'll be a welcome face.]
Sword auras repeatedly left traces in the sky. Murakan quickly changed directions, avoiding some and blocking others with the protective shield.
"Murakan...! You've finally extended your devilish claws to the Storm Castle! Yes, I've been desperate to find you and avenge the lord. Come down, I will kill you!"
[Ah, this voice. I feel like I remember who it is.]
Jin had never heard this voice before.
So far, Jin had confirmed a total of six Ten Knights through records and reality: Silderay, Diana, Sarah, Padler, Lokia, and Bale.
The Ten Knight, who was now furiously shooting sword auras into the sky as if to tear it apart, was one of the remaining four.
[I need to go down and take a look at his face.]
"His aura is quite menacing. Will you be okay?"
[Are you asking me, Murakan, if I'll be okay? Are you kidding?]
"Yes, it's a joke."

Murakan dived towards the direction from where the sword auras were flying. During that brief moment, dozens of sword auras flew towards him, some of which even grazed Murakan's body, but none caused any damage.

With a whoosh, the trees were crushed by Murakan's wings and body, revealing the Ten Knight. He was a man who used a chain sword, and the long scar on his face and flowing hair left a strong impression.
"Are you ignoring me? You've come down to the ground on your own accord."
"[Ah! Dranax, it's you!]"

Murakan immediately recalled his memory of him. Dranax Runcandel, a character who was famous as the 'Camal' family's patriarch, the loser of the south of Hypester a thousand years ago. Like most of the Ten Great Knights, he followed Temar and changed his castle.
"Don't call my name with that dirty mouth, it makes me feel like vomiting."
[Wow, how could I have forgotten about you? You got along really well with me.]
"What kind of nonsense are you spouting?"
[You were the type to solve things with your fists just like me, right? So it's better to talk to someone else. I'm going to head towards the Storm Castle, so I'll see you later, okay?]
"What? Stay there! You bastard, I said stay...!"

Murakan increased his altitude again, blocking and dodging Dranax' sword aura. Even if the Ten Great Knights are impressive, catching Murakan who is determined to escape is too much. This was because it was impossible to disturb his flight by releasing energy like ordinary dragons.

[Just for the record, I'm the real one, ah, I misspoke. I am the real Murakan and the one who made Temar like this is the fake! Someone will probably explain it to you when you return to Storm Castle!]
"Kuahhh! I'll kill you! Come here, come here! I'll kill you!"
Dranax' angry shout was quickly fading away. Overwhelmed by anger, Dranax fired sword aura towards the back of the group, releasing energy.
"Wouldn't it have been better to just calmly explain? It seems like you've only agitated him more."
[You don't know him well. Unless a colleague who he perceives to be smarter than him explains it, he absolutely won't understand.]
"So, you weren't such a colleague?"
[As you know, not only is my body impressive, but so is my brain, but he never knew that. Totally headstrong, completely headstrong.]
Soon, Murakan arrived at the entrance of the Storm Castle.
There, two of the Ten Great Knights and the chosen elite knights were leaning against the city walls, waiting for the group.

"Murakan... It seems that you've come to Storm Castle today to settle things. It pains me to see your fallen self. Now we will wash away your hideous sins with death, and hope that you feel some remorse before you disappear."

[Wait a minute! I didn't come here to fight. I came to reveal the truth. Luckily, someone who can understand is waiting. Hey, Frey! Yeah, you're Frey Runcandel, right? I'm not the one who took down Temar, it was the real Mura... ah, damn, I did it again! He's the fake, and I'm the real one. I'll explain it in detail, so put your sword down.]

"Until the end, you're belittling us. Hell itself won't be able to contain your sins. Then, this is the end of the conversation. I can't wish you good luck like when we were colleagues. Instead, I'll curse you. Everyone, attack!"
[No, wait a minute, listen to me!]
Murakan cried out desperately, but the knights didn't hesitate for a moment and fired their sword auras.
